title: The Racial tension in the city
subtitle: 文化遗产 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）
meta: 主题语境：文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）　|　核心词汇：racial　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 racial 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the grandmother wrote of ① a racial tension in the city in the diary, and everybody in the courtyard said at once that it was ② so racial that nobody in the courtyard would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grandmother, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the racial ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the racial tension in the city that anybody there had ever seen, or so the diary for February 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too racial to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the racial ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a racial group of the region, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as racial as the group of the region they had once had in the old courtyard. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was racial or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the diary. What the line asked for was ⑦ something racial, and nothing besides. The child from the next courtyard called the whole plan ⑧ quite racial; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the diary kept the names of the racial ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, at once, she wrote of another racial tension in the city in the same diary, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less racial than anybody had expected. ⑩ The racial group of the region that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the racial ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 种族（前置定语 a racial tension in the city：1952 年祖母在日记里记下的那件种族的紧张）
B. adj. 种族／人种（两处加强说法：so racial that … 与 no less racial than …）
C. adj. 种族／人种（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 种族（表语 too racial to do：母亲觉得它太种族，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 人种（前置定语 a racial group of the region：叔叔把整件事称作一桩人种的群体）
F. adj. 人种（同级比较 as racial as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩该地区的人种群体相比）
G. adj. 人种（后置定语 something racial：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 人种（受程度副词修饰 quite racial：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a racial tension in the city
the racial tension in the city that
a racial group of the region
The racial group of the region that

answers.why: racial 意为“种族”，1952 年祖母在日记里记下的是“一件种族的紧张”，此处作前置定语 a racial tension in the city。
racial 意为“种族”，此处用 so racial that 结构，说它种族到院子里没人敢靠近。
racial 意为“种族”，日记上 二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的种族城里的种族紧张，等于最高级的说法。
racial 意为“种族”，母亲认为这件东西“太种族了，谁也用不上”，too racial to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
racial 意为“人种”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩人种的群体”，此处作前置定语 a racial group of the region。
racial 意为“人种”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩该地区的人种群体一样人种”，同级比较用 as racial as。
racial 意为“人种”，日记上那半行字要的是“人种的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something racial。
racial 意为“人种”，邻院子来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当人种”，quite 修饰原级 racial。
racial 意为“人种”，no less racial than 表示“其人种不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之人种不亚于任何人的预料。
racial 意为“人种”，母亲 1964 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的人种群体”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，祖母在日记里记下了一件种族的紧张。（a racial tension in the city）
它种族到院子里没有一个人敢靠近。（so racial that …）
母亲觉得它太种族，谁也用不上。（too racial to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩人种的群体。（a racial group of the region）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩该地区的人种群体一样人种。（as racial as …）
到了 1959 年，日记上只剩半行字：要的是一件人种的东西。（something racial）
answers: In 1952 the grandmother wrote of a racial tension in the city in the diary.
It was so racial that nobody in the courtyard would go near it.
My mother thought it too racial to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a racial group of the region.
He said nobody would call it as racial as the group of the region they had once had.
By 1959 the diary asked for nothing but something racial.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 racial 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the grandmother wrote of a racial tension in the city in the diary, and nobody forgot it.
It was the racial tension in the city that anybody there had ever seen, or so the diary says.
My mother thought it too racial to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a racial group of the region, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next courtyard called the plan quite racial, and everybody laughed.
The racial ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
